about: FETCH! title regrid: local grid fit of title_original.png (2400x1792) to 320x240 cells. x_borders[j] lists the 321 x positions (source px, border between pixel b-1 and b) of the cell borders in cell row j; y_borders[i] lists the 241 y positions in cell column i. Cell (i, j) covers x in [x_borders[j][i], x_borders[j][i+1]) and y in [y_borders[i][j], y_borders[i][j+1]). cells_x0/x1/y0/y1 give the same boxes as 240 x 320 arrays (row j, column i).
